details: Designed, built, and led the end-to-end fleetwide rollout of UMEMD, a user-space out-of-memory daemon that proactively evicts lower-priority containers before the kernel OOM killer locks up hosts; in production fleetwide and in enforcement mode across the stateless fleet.

Shipped full production readiness for UMEMD per-host and aggregated metrics, alerting with automated rollback gates, oncall runbooks, and synthetic validation and drove adoption with the batch, stateful, and stateless platform teams.

Led an M3 time-series cost-optimization initiative across uhostd/node_exporter, reducing metric ingestion from 36.5M to 27M writes/sec and daily platform spend from \$12K to \$7K (\$1.25M in annualized savings) with zero loss of observability or alerting coverage.

Cut an additional ~\$200K/year by migrating stats-collector resolution from 5s to 10s, driven by per-metric RPS/core/\$-per-year analysis and dependent changes landed across uhostd, centralcollector, and the M3 platform.

Led the ZRAM memory-efficiency rollout onto Presto's Kubernetes hosts to reduce oncall toil, workload latency, and memory footprint; authored the PRR with tiered rollback and emergency remediation paths and staged low-traffic high-traffic fleetwide with no regressions.
Executed fleetwide OS and runtime migrations with zero downtime: Debian 11-12 across 200,000 machines, cgroup v2 on 4,000+ machines, and OCI OL8 on 5,000+ machines.

Mentored a summer intern from prototype to production on the DAMON cold-memory observability rollout (Go, Python, Starlark), and benchmarked transparent huge page (THP) kernel settings with JVM and Go service teams to lower RSS and prevent OOM-driven incidents.
Led a full-stack healthcare PDF generation platform from design through production delivery.
Migrated production services to a new authentication and identity provider with zero downtime.
Built and launched spot-market pricing features that generated \$1.2M+ in revenue.
